discussion_comments.comment_body: Right — the desktop 4s timeout only abandoned the client promise. Added a server-side bound in `on_list_provider_supported_models`: `tokio::time::timeout(SUPPORTED_MODELS_TIMEOUT /* 10s */, provider.fetch_supported_models())`. On elapse the future is dropped, which tears down the outstanding fetch and (for Claude Code) its spawned child via the provider's `Drop`, instead of leaking a permanent request/subprocess. The desktop timeout stays as defense-in-depth.

I notice a lot of needing to reset these in parallel.

Maybe we need some kind of `PromptLifecycle` enum with a fixed set of states the entry/session could move between?
